title: Carbide Create Job Weekly Tool Wear Percent Trend
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=carbide:job tool_wear_pct=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(tool_wear_pct) as avg_duration, max(tool_wear_pct) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst tool wear percent for Carbide Create job events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture tool_wear_pct on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average tool wear percent with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It smartly whether Carbide Create job tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
